retrievalProfile.description: A tight, square-format portrait of a musician in a Santa costume playing a brass instrument, featuring interlocking swash typography across the hat.
triggerTerms: musician in Santa suit playing trumpet
tight portrait with white beard and brass instrument
excludeWhen: modern minimalist digital art is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, square-cropped photograph of a man with dark eyes wearing a white Santa hat and a voluminous, textured white beard. He is holding a gold trumpet to his lips. The top portion of the hat serves as a canvas for two distinct styles of interlocking, decorative typography in green and orange-red.
coreVisualRelationships: The trumpet mouthpiece acts as the central focal point where the beard and hands converge.
The white Santa hat provides a high-contrast background for the colorful typography.
The dark eyes of the subject create a direct gaze that anchors the composition.
The texture of the synthetic beard fills the lower two-thirds of the frame.
coreInvariants: Tight square crop focusing on the face from forehead to hands.
Subject must be playing a brass instrument.
Typography must be placed on the white fabric of the hat.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered horizontally, with the face occupying the middle third and the beard filling the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the gold trumpet mouthpiece.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the trumpet, then up to the decorative text on the hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subject's features and costume.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value whites with saturated, mid-century graphic accents.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy use of decorative curls and loops
Tight letter spacing with overlapping elements
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature extended, spiraling swashes that cradle the lowercase letters.

treatment.fill: Solid green with thin dark outline

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a green decorative script-like serif and a secondary orange-red swash serif.

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast and tight spacing potential

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A square close-up photo of a man with dark eyes wearing a white Santa hat and a large, curly white beard, holding a gold trumpet to his lips. The lighting is soft and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of decorative, interlocking swash typography in the upper third of the image, specifically on the white area of the hat. Use green for the top line and orange-red for the bottom line.

verificationChecks: Is the crop a tight square?
Is the typography interlocking and decorative?
Is the trumpet visible and being played?
Is the text placed on the hat?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the eyes are sharp and expressive.
Ensure the gold of the trumpet has a realistic metallic sheen.
Verify the typography does not obscure the subject's eyes.
Confirm the beard texture looks fibrous rather than a solid mass.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a tight portrait of a themed character, use the headwear as a graphic canvas for high-contrast decorative swash lettering, and anchor the base with a relevant prop.
